invariants: Every nontrivial model/API/compute execution must receive a cost reservation before execution.
Checked-in paid execution defaults to DENY and all checked-in paid USD/token/model-call ceilings are zero.
Tier 0 deterministic work remains preferred and can be admitted only with zero model tokens and zero model cost.
Open reservations count against budgets so concurrent work cannot oversubscribe a limit.
Expired reservations are conservatively settled at their reserved maximum instead of silently releasing budget.
Idempotency keys suppress repeated spend and conflicting key reuse fails closed.
Actual usage above any reservation trips the emergency stop and blocks future reservations.
Cost authorization never grants OBSERVE, EXPERIMENT, MODIFY or ACT authority and cannot approve consequential actions.
Customer communication, payments, live trading, deployment and downstream authority remain governed elsewhere.
Only sanitized identifiers, hashes, counts, token totals, compute minutes, costs and evidence references may be persisted while BLK-005 is open.
